text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not wanting to lose to Vodka, Daiwa Scarlet shows off how much she has improved at a scrimmage before the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, the day of the Shuka Sho arrives. It's time for the two rivals to show each other how much they've grown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Deeming Scarlet a worthy opponent, Vodka gears up for a challenge. Both have trained extensively, and recognize each other's progress. Now, we'll see just who's on top!
